item.title: How Much May We Pay to Free Hostages? | Torah & Israel
item.description:
What does halacha say about paying ransom for captives, and can the price be too high? The Mishnah in Gittin forbids redeeming above their worth, with two reasons: the burden on the community and encouraging more kidnapping. Also the exceptions, and Rabbi Yishmael, taught in the weeks after 7 October.

item.title: May a Spy Set a Honey Trap? Esther, Yael and Halacha | Torah & Israel
item.description:
Can the story of Esther and Yael justify a spy using a honey trap? After defining the method and its real cases, the Rabbi starts from the rule of yehareg veal yaavor and the three cardinal sins, and then examines the Shulhan Arukh, the Rema and the sources in Megillah, Nazir and Yevamot.

item.title: Why Is Electricity Forbidden on Shabbat? Phones for Soldiers' Families | Torah & Israel
item.description:
Can a phone stay on over Shabbat for news of soldiers or a sick relative? To answer it, the class asks why electricity is forbidden at all, drawing on Rav Shlomo Zalman Auerbach, Rav Asher Weiss, the Yerushalmi and Eres Hemdah. Where one can actually help, the question does not arise.
